title: World average rice, milled yield
source: USDA Foreign Agricultural Service, Production Supply and Distribution
note: World production over world area harvested, which is how the department derives the world yield; the bulk file carries countries only. Years are the contract's: the marketing year the database labels 2025 is the 2026 contract, because the event question names the second year of the marketing year. A contract resolves on the first report after the marketing year ends, and surpassing a threshold means strictly greater than it.
